data.name: Devkiransh
data.long_meaning: The name Devkiransh is derived from Sanskrit language. It is a compound of two words: Deva (God) and Kiransh (graceful form). The name represents the divine grace bestowed upon an individual. It signifies the blessings of the gods and the manifestation of their presence in one's life.

in_sanskrit.name: देवकिरन्श
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: God's gracious and divine gift, a name with divine blessings and auspiciousness (Deva - god, Kira - gift, Ansh - divine, auspicious)
